admission.justification: Cross-owner head/block composition can otherwise duplicate the same content while every individual component appears correct.

conditions: Objective and primary-requirement text are not repeated in free-form or other blocks.
References and reports share one placed heading.
exclusions: Removing access to a distinct free-form section.
Repeated references on another independently opened surface.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/detail-panel/task-references.test.tsx: 'places the one References heading before Further notes with the Notes line last'; dashboard/src/panels/detail-panel/skeleton-notwice.test.tsx (unchanged, green); notes/reports/worker/7b2c4e19-5d63-4a8f-b1e0-127000000a01/evidence-f6/sandbox/look2-capture.json (objectiveBlocks 1 on every form)

statement: Nothing stands twice on a task page: references and reports share one heading, the text of the primary requirement stands once, and the objective stands once.
